stories.title: Sensex, Nifty open higher as falling crude, easing geopolitical tension boost market sentiment - DD News
Sensex and Nifty extend losses to five sessions
stories.summary: Indian benchmark indices fell for a fifth consecutive session as geopolitical tensions in West Asia and US trade tariff concerns weighed on sentiment. The BSE Sensex dropped 331 points to 76,059.17. Investors remain cautious, though the market has been asked to remain resilient by various analysts.

stories.title: Sensex climbs 773 points on lower energy prices
stories.summary: Indian equity benchmarks closed higher on Wednesday as lower oil prices and improved foreign investor sentiment supported a rally. The Sensex advanced 773 points to 81,879.40, while the Nifty gained 210 points. The indices pared some intra-day gains before the close of trade.

stories.title: IT stocks lead 1,109 point Sensex recovery
stories.summary: Indian equity markets staged a recovery on Tuesday, with the Sensex surging 1,109 points to 73,033.78. IT stocks led the rally, climbing over 5 percent following positive sentiment around HCL Technologies earnings. The recovery reflected selective buying in sectors offering greater earnings, according to PL Capital.

stories.title: IT stocks lead market decline on oil price fears
stories.summary: Domestic equity benchmarks opened lower on Wednesday, with the Nifty 50 falling over 100 points and the Sensex dropping 350 points. IT stocks led the losses, with the Nifty IT index falling 3 percent. Investors remain cautious amid rising crude oil prices and Middle East tensions.

stories.title: Indian markets maintain weekly gains
stories.summary: Indian equity benchmarks ended higher for the third consecutive week, despite volatility linked to the Jensen Huang controversy. The country has traditionally been considered an anti-AI bet, and new developments are expected to affect future investments. Gains remained modest as the market faced pressure on Friday.

stories.title: Market rally pauses as inflation breaches limit
stories.summary: Indian equities snapped a three-session winning streak as the Sensex fell 318 points to 81,592.45. Sentiment was impacted by retail inflation climbing to 6.09 percent, breaching the Reserve Bank of India upper tolerance limit of 6 percent. Profit booking followed a sharp rally in global technology stocks.

stories.title: Profit taking and inflation weigh on indices
stories.summary: Benchmark indices declined on Friday, though they sustained weekly gains despite heavy foreign institutional buying. October retail inflation of 6.09 percent breached the RBI threshold, prompting investors to book profits. Rising inflation has revived concerns over the interest rate outlook for the coming months.

stories.title: Sensex and Nifty plunge over 2 percent
stories.summary: Indian equity benchmarks dropped over 2 percent in early trade Thursday following a speech by US President Donald Trump regarding the Middle East conflict. The Sensex fell 1,518 points to 71,616.03, erasing gains from the previous session. The market reacted sharply to the lack of a timeline.

stories.title: Indian equity market extends rally for third week
stories.summary: The Indian equity market extended gains for a third consecutive week, supported by foreign institutional buying and a rebound in US Treasury yields. PSU banks emerged as top weekly contributors. Sentiment was weighed by corporate earnings, volatile crude oil prices and hotter than expected retail inflation data.

stories.title: Nifty bulls face resistance levels
stories.summary: The Nifty has staged a recovery after testing the lower boundary of a consolidation structure, moving back above its 50-week moving average. Immediate resistance is expected at 25,425 and 25,550. The weekly RSI remains in bullish territory, though it does not show divergence against the price.

stories.title: Mixed results for Indian firms in Q2
stories.summary: Second quarter results for 2026 showed varied performance across sectors. Tata Motors PV, Grasim and Religare Enterprises reported losses, while Eicher Motors, Gillette India, Shriram Properties and Manipal Hospitals posted gains. The results highlight a diverse range of outcomes for companies listed on the exchange.

stories.title: U.S. Stocks Mixed on Nvidia Fallout Fears - WSJ
Tech Stocks Fall as Next Week Brings Big Tests for the AI Trade | Markets P.M. for Nov. 13 - WSJ
AMD and other chip stocks slide as Wall Street rethinks the AI trade without Jensen Huang - MarketWatch
Wall Street slides as Nvidia uncertainty persists
stories.summary: US stocks fell on Friday as concerns regarding Nvidia pressured technology shares. Nvidia shares dropped 2.2 percent, marking their sixth straight week of declines following the resignation of CEO Jensen Huang. Inflation data failed to alter expectations for further interest rate hikes from the Federal Reserve.

stories.title: Wall Street Reverses Early Gains as Nvidia Fallout Rattles Tech Stocks - GV Wire
Wall Street opens mixed as Nvidia reverses lower and Cerebras jumps 15% after a cooler PPI - MLQ.ai
Nvidia shares slide as leadership turmoil hits tech sector
stories.summary: Nvidia shares dropped 3.3 percent, heading for their longest weekly losing streak since 2012. CEO Jensen Huang resigned following scrutiny of his relationship with a businesswoman suspected of spying for Chinese intelligence. The broader AI trade is under pressure as the chipmaker’s central role faces new questions.

stories.title: Nvidia selloff deepens as CEO resigns
stories.summary: Nvidia shares plunged 4.3 percent, marking their longest weekly losing streak since 2012. CEO Jensen Huang resigned on Thursday following scrutiny of his relationship with a woman suspected of spying for Beijing. The Philadelphia semiconductor index fell 6 percent as investors reassess the broader AI trade.

stories.title: Market volatility tests investor resolve
stories.summary: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 have seen average daily moves of 1.6 percent and 2.4 percent respectively this November. While inflation data eased rate hike fears, the sudden downfall of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has shaken one of the bull market’s biggest bets. Timing remains everything.

stories.title: Nvidia and Anthropic face high-stakes week
stories.summary: Nvidia shares tumbled following controversies involving CEO Jensen Huang, who stepped down after revelations of extramarital affairs, including one with a suspected Chinese spy. Investors now look toward Tuesday’s quarterly report and the upcoming Anthropic IPO to gauge the current sentiment on the AI trade.

stories.title: RBI updates bank capital calculation rules
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India revised guidelines for including quarterly profits in core capital calculations, removing a condition linked to non-performing asset provisioning. The move affects the Capital to Risk Weighted Assets Ratio, a key indicator used to measure a bank’s financial strength and loss-absorbing capacity.

stories.title: RBI to clarify expected credit loss framework
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India plans to issue an FAQ document to clarify its expected credit loss framework. The regulator met with bank CEOs and board directors on November 12 to discuss implementation preparedness and address concerns regarding loan category treatment and specific provisioning requirements.

stories.title: Yes Bank seeks Supreme Court review on bond write-off
stories.summary: Yes Bank has filed a petition to review a Supreme Court order that upheld a ruling quashing the bank's decision to write off 8,415 crore rupees in AT-1 bonds. These perpetual bonds were written off during the lender's financial difficulties, a move now under renewed legal scrutiny.

stories.title: Yes Bank faces contempt petition over bond dispute
stories.summary: Axis Trustee Services filed a contempt petition alleging Yes Bank failed to provide a roadmap for restoring AT-1 bonds. The Supreme Court recently upheld a ruling setting aside the write-off of the bonds. The lender, now 24 percent owned by Sumitomo Mitsui, continues to evaluate its capital actions.

stories.title: BCAS urges SEBI to allow CA firms to monitor fund use in smaller issues - Moneycontrol.com
Chartered accountants seek role in IPO monitoring
stories.summary: The Bombay Chartered Accountants’ Society suggested that qualified firms should act as monitoring agencies for companies raising funds. SEBI currently restricts this role to credit rating agencies. The society argues that extending the mandate to all issues will significantly increase the workload for existing monitoring agencies.

stories.title: Gold-lending rules trigger repayment stress for NBFCs
stories.summary: Bajaj Finance, Manappuram, Muthoot, and Shriram Finance reported a rise in overdue gold loans following the RBI’s revised framework implemented in April. Muthoot’s standalone stage 2 loans jumped to 23,467 crore rupees from 1,876 crore in June. The industry is adjusting to the end of bullet repayments.

stories.title: NCLAT rules on merger scheme requirements
stories.summary: The National Company Law Appellate Tribunal held that companies do not need a no-objection certificate from the ED or RBI for mergers if there are no allegations of FEMA violations. The tribunal noted that regulatory intervention is only required when there is evidence of a guideline breach.

stories.title: India current account deficit widens to 25.8 billion dollars
stories.summary: India’s current account deficit widened to 25.8 billion dollars in the first half of the 2026-27 financial year, up from 18 billion dollars a year ago. The Reserve Bank of India reported that the merchandise trade deficit expanded, though the overall balance of payments swung to a surplus.

stories.title: Tax department probes suspicious foreign remittances
stories.summary: The Income Tax Department launched a nationwide verification of entities transferring large amounts of foreign exchange despite reporting minimal turnover. The investigation follows analysis of outward remittances and targets fictitious charitable trusts allegedly providing accommodation entries against bogus donations.

stories.title: Government notifies new income tax compliance rules
stories.summary: The government notified the Income Tax Rules 2026, effective April 1, to overhaul direct taxation procedures. The rules tighten dividend declaration requirements, mandating that companies maintain share registers and pay dividends only within India. Stock exchange compliance mechanisms have also been strengthened under the new regime.

stories.title: India's Paytm gets preliminary RBI nod for wallet licence, shares hit record high - Reuters
Paytm receives preliminary approval to restart digital wallet business
stories.summary: Paytm has secured in-principle authorisation from the Reserve Bank of India to issue prepaid payment instruments. The fintech company must now meet specific regulatory conditions and obtain final approval before it can resume the wallet services that were disrupted by oversight actions two years ago.

stories.title: Paytm Gets RBI In-Principle Nod For Digital Wallet Licence, Moves Closer To Wallet Revival - BW Disrupt
stories.summary: Paytm's wholly owned subsidiary, Paytm Payments Services Ltd (PPSL), has received in-principle authorisation from the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to set up and operate a payment system for issuing and managing prepaid payment instruments (PPIs), including digital wallets. According to a media report, the fintech major disclosed the development

stories.title: Paytm shares hit record high on RBI nod to revive digital wallet - Dealroom
Paytm wallet likely to see revival following RBI's in-principle nod
stories.summary: The approval opens a path for the Noida-based fintech to bring back a product it lost nearly three years ago, when the regulator acted against its associate entity Paytm Payments Bank (PPBL), restricting its operations. Shares of One 97 Communications, which runs Paytm, rose as much as 1.8 per cent

stories.title: Airtel Payments Bank eyes public market debut
stories.summary: Bharti Airtel’s financial services arm could pursue an initial public offering within three to four years, according to Chairman Sunil Bharti Mittal. The company aims to reach 10,000 crore rupees in revenue and deposits, with Mittal describing the subsidiary as a sleeping giant in the sector.

stories.title: UPI transaction value hits record 314 lakh crore rupees in fiscal 2026
stories.summary: India’s Unified Payments Interface processed 314.23 lakh crore rupees in transaction value during the 2025-26 financial year. The platform reached 55.49 crore users by June 2026, continuing a trend of sustained growth in both volume and value over the past five years.

stories.title: UPI transaction volume grows 23 percent in September
stories.summary: The Unified Payments Interface processed 24.07 billion transactions in September, a 23 percent increase compared to the previous year. Daily activity averaged 802 million transactions, with the total monthly value reaching 29.37 lakh crore rupees, according to data from the National Payments Corporation of India.

stories.title: Qatar Post launches UPI-linked remittance service for India
stories.summary: A new digital remittance service now allows users in Qatar to send money directly to UPI-enabled bank accounts in India through Qatar Post outlets. The initiative, which launched on August 15, integrates postal networks with India’s digital payment infrastructure to facilitate cross-border transfers.

stories.title: MobiKwik fined 9 lakh rupees for regulatory lapses
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has imposed a 9 lakh rupee penalty on MobiKwik for failing to comply with prepaid payment instrument directions. The regulator cited the company for allowing fund transfers to non-registered beneficiaries beyond prescribed limits and failing to report certain frauds on time.

stories.title: RBI Fines Mobikwik Rs 9 Lakh Over PPI Violations, Fraud Delays
stories.summary: RBI penalty on Mobikwik amounts to Rs 9 lakh for prepaid payment instrument violations and delayed fraud reporting, following a regulatory inspection The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has imposed a monetary penalty of Rs 9 lakh on One Mobikwik Systems Limited for non-compliance with regulatory directions governing prepaid payment

stories.title: Is All Money In Your Bank Account Your Income? A Rs 3.69-Crore Tax Case Has An Answer - NDTV Profit
Tribunal rules in favor of taxpayer in 3.69 crore rupee case
stories.summary: The Income Tax Appellate Tribunal deleted a 3.69 crore rupee tax addition imposed on a taxpayer whose accounts were used for third-party bangle trade payments. The tribunal ruled that authorities could not treat the deposits as unexplained income without proving the money belonged to the account holder.

stories.title: Income tax on gifts: What qualifies as movable property, how gifts are taxed, when exemptions are available? Explained |
stories.summary: Receiving gifts of movable property from family or friends does not always mean you are free from tax. While some gifts are exempt, others, such as jewellery, shares, or gold, can be taxable depending on their value and who gives them. Even buying certain movable assets at a price lower

stories.title: Parents warned of income clubbing rules for child investments
stories.summary: Parents investing in their child's name should be aware of tax clubbing provisions under the Income-tax Act. Income generated from these investments is typically added to the return of the parent with the higher total income, meaning such gifts do not necessarily reduce a family's overall tax liability.

stories.title: Tax authorities scrutinize property purchases in family names
stories.summary: Buying property in the name of a spouse or parent can attract scrutiny if the individual lacks independent income to justify the purchase. Buyers must distinguish between genuine gifts and benami transactions, as authorities may investigate the source of funds and the actual ownership of the asset.

stories.title: Banks raise fixed deposit interest rates
stories.summary: Several lenders have increased interest rates on fixed deposits to attract household savings amid strong loan demand and tighter liquidity. While the recent repo rate increase is a factor, banks are competing to secure funding as credit growth continues to outpace deposit growth.

stories.title: Small finance banks offer higher fixed deposit rates
stories.summary: Small finance banks and select private lenders are currently offering fixed deposit rates reaching 8.2 percent for regular depositors. According to data from Stable Money, Jana Small Finance Bank leads for regular depositors, while Bandhan Bank offers up to 8.25 percent for senior citizens.

stories.title: Mutual funds versus Post Office recurring deposits
stories.summary: Investors choosing between a ₹10,000 monthly SIP in a mutual fund and a Post Office Recurring Deposit face different outcomes. Mutual funds offer market-linked returns with higher potential and risk, while the Post Office provides predictable returns. The final corpus depends on the chosen path and market conditions.

stories.title: Income Tax Department launches FAST-DS 2026 scheme
stories.summary: The Income Tax Department introduced the FAST-DS 2026 scheme to allow taxpayers to voluntarily disclose previously unreported foreign assets and income. The initiative aims to increase transparency and boost compliance. Eligible individuals must submit Form 1 by December 31, 2026, to participate in the one-time disclosure program.

stories.title: UPI expands to Greece and the Maldives
stories.summary: The Unified Payments Interface, developed by the National Payments Corporation of India, is now accepted in 11 countries. Greece and the Maldives are the latest to adopt the real-time payment platform. The system was designed to create a simple and secure payment ecosystem for every citizen.

stories.title: Government clarifies family pension eligibility rules
stories.summary: The government issued an Office Memorandum clarifying income limits and dependency conditions for family pensions. While eligibility varies by relationship and financial status, a legally wedded spouse is not subject to an income ceiling. Not every family member is automatically entitled to receive the pension after a death.

stories.title: Karnataka High Court rules on professor pension dispute
stories.summary: A professor who served 28 years in academia was denied pension benefits under the Old Pension Scheme after switching universities. The Karnataka High Court ruled in his favor after the state government challenged an order to release his benefits. Changing employers can complicate retirement plans.
